SHIP GEOMETRY

Voyager Versus 2.20.45 and later: the three fighters (VX-01 Dart, VX-02 Bulwark,
VX-03 Wraith) are original Voyager designs built from primitives at load time in
voyager-ships.mjs. No third-party ship geometry is bundled.

Earlier versions used public RSI holoviewer meshes; those files and the CTM
decoder were removed in 2.20.45.

Three.js license: vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt.
Voyager-authored 4K PBR surface maps: materials/manifest.json.
